system_thesis: VibeFlow is a speculative compact input device for creative professionals embracing VibeCoding — the paradigm where users express intent through natural language and AI generates. The visual system conveys creative vitality, multimodal fluidity, and approachable technology through warm gradients, rounded geometry, and tactile material contrasts.

derived_from.rationale: No existing brand identity. Product name 'VibeFlow' coined to capture the VibeCoding interaction paradigm + creative flow state.

palette.strategy: Warm creative-vitality palette anchored in coral-to-amber gradients, balanced with deep teal for contrast and soft lavender for creative energy. Matte surfaces dominate with selective gloss on interactive elements.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Primary accent for hero colorway shell, AI key cap, interactive highlights

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Gradient transition from coral, knob indicator, active state glow

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Ocean Depth colorway base, text on light surfaces, depth shadows

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Tertiary colorway accent, touch-zone indicator, mode-switch highlight

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Light matte body surface, background for product renders, gallery backdrop

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, keycap legends, deep shadows, outline strokes

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Dark matte surfaces, secondary text, keycap sides

tokens.name: gloss-white
tokens.usage: Glossy keycap tops, specular highlights, interactive element sheen

typography.strategy: Geometric sans-serif for product identity (friendly, modern, approachable), paired with monospace for technical annotations. All text in rendered PNGs follows these roles.

display.family: geometric sans-serif (e.g. Poppins, Plus Jakarta Sans)
display.usage: Product name 'VibeFlow', section headers in system boards

caption.usage: Feature names, interaction zone labels, CMF swatch labels

annotation.family: monospace (e.g. JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono)
annotation.usage: Dimension callouts, material specs, technical annotations

grid.strategy: 8px base unit for all renders. Product renders use centered composition with generous negative space. System boards use 4-column grid with 24px gutters.
grid.product_render_composition: centered, 45-degree hero angle or straight-on front view, 15-20% margin

motif_system.name: flow-curves
motif_system.description: Organic rounded geometry reflecting the product's rounded corners and the creative flow concept. Gradient transitions between palette tokens echo the multimodal interaction blending. No hard corners in decorative elements.
elements: Rounded rectangles with 12-16px corner radius for UI frames
Soft arc shapes suggesting gesture motion paths
avoid: Neon glow effects or RGB lighting clichés

voice.tone: Warm, confident, slightly playful. Speaks to creative professionals as peers, not as tech enthusiasts.

imagery_strategy.approach: Product-first renders with clean studio lighting for hero/three-view. Lifestyle scenes show hands interacting with the device in creative work contexts (design tablet nearby, coffee cup, notebook). Back-of-hand and over-shoulder perspectives preferred over face shots.
imagery_strategy.lighting: Soft directional key light from upper-left, subtle fill, gentle shadows. No harsh specular except on gloss elements.
imagery_strategy.background: Warm neutral surfaces (light wood, concrete, linen) for lifestyle. Solid surface-tone or very subtle gradient for studio renders.
imagery_strategy.people: Hands only — showing gesture interaction, finger on touch strip, hand on knob. Diverse skin tones across renders.

lockup.lockup_rules: Wordmark 'VibeFlow' in display weight, tagline in caption weight below or to right. Always on surface or ink. Never on gradient backgrounds without contrast backing.
lockup.logo_mark: Rounded 'V' with gradient stroke from coral to amber, suggesting a flow arrow

must_preserve: Rounded corner radius: 12mm body corners, 2mm keycap corners
Interaction zone placement: touch strip left edge, rotary knob top-right, AI key cluster right of spacebar
Magnetic expansion port: right side edge, rectangular with rounded corners
Keycap profile: low-profile rounded cherry, matte top with subtle dish
Colorway shell: removable panels with visible seam line at 2mm inset from edge
consistency_lock.preservation_method: Designer must reference 02-three-view.png as the canonical geometry anchor for all subsequent renders. Edit from this anchor when possible. Maintain identical proportions, zone placement, and corner radii across all views.

asset_usage_policy.reference_assets: Use research assets as style/proportion references only. Do not reproduce competitor product details verbatim (see brand_lock.md do-not-duplicate list).
asset_usage_policy.edit_vs_generate: Prefer image_generate for original product renders. Use image_edit only when adapting a reference for mood/composition study, not for final deliverables.
asset_usage_policy.protected_assets: No protected brand assets in this run (speculative concept).

do_not_use: Gaming keyboard aesthetics (aggressive angles, red-black colorway)
Transparent case showing PCB (too techy for creative audience)
Pure white or pure black backgrounds (use warm neutrals)
Naya Connect's exact magnetic connector layout
